description: Mutations for Print lifecycle, layer selection, coordinate conversion, support preview, collision and cache workflows.

mutants.description: Use the minimum configured nozzle when computing the safe maximum layer height; the dual-nozzle collection case expects the 0.8 mm maximum.
Reverse the public object-layer ordering comparator; the multi-object case checks the returned order and area relation.
Apply the plate origin in the wrong direction for floating-point print-space conversion.
Apply the plate origin in the wrong direction for scaled-point print-space conversion.

mutants.old:
coordf_t limit = print_z - epsilon;
    auto it = Slic3r::lower_bound_by_predicate(m_layers.begin(), m_layers.end(), [limit](const Layer *layer) { return layer->print_z < limit; });
mutants.new:
coordf_t limit = print_z - epsilon;
    auto it = Slic3r::lower_bound_by_predicate(m_layers.begin(), m_layers.end(), [limit](const Layer *layer) { return layer->print_z > limit; });
mutants.description: Reverse the lower-bound predicate used by approximate print-Z lookup; exact and epsilon lookups must still resolve the middle layer.
Reverse the upper tolerance check for approximate print-Z lookup; the above-tolerance negative control must remain null.
Reverse the first candidate test in bottom-Z lookup; exact and above-tolerance bottom queries provide independent checks.
Select layers below rather than within the requested range; every returned layer is required to stay inside the requested Z bounds.
Reverse the upper bound in get_certain_layers; the selected layer set must include only the requested in-range layers.
Skip support generation in the public preview workflow; the overhang fixture requires nonempty support layers and polygons.
Suppress the colliding footprint output while leaving the collision message; the negative-control case requires both.
Treat successful cache-directory creation as failure; the export contract requires a zero return and nonempty object payload.
